_description: Versioned issue rules for topology fact resolution, in the POC's fact-map.yaml `issues:` shape. Each rule is evaluated by the same condition engine as the POC (missing_path, conflicting_candidates, all_paths_present, truthy_with_missing_or_false, unit_missing, declared_ports_not_curated). Only rules for facts the production catalog can actually supply are included; do not add a rule for a fact path with no real source, since that would fabricate a gap that can never be resolved.
